title: Egyptian Chickpea Wrap
description: A flavorful and hearty Egyptian-inspired wrap filled with chickpeas, malty spices, and quaint herbs.

ingredients.name: Egyptian spice mix
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern grocery stores

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the Egyptian spice mix and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chickpeas and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Warm the quaint wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spreading the malty hummus on the wrap, followed by the chickpea mixture.
Top with chopped parsley and serve.
